purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Truck Order Generation Truck Order Summary RF details.
features: This feature allows the user to Generate FCL and PDF files for the Door Address Linked Booking.

events.description: Generates the FCL and PDF files (Truck Order Summary RF) for the selected Door Address Linked bookings.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the ☰ icon next to Truck Order Generation and selects "Truck Order Summary RF".
